title: Unsound Multiple Exclusive References from Raw Pointer
pattern: A raw pointer (`*mut T`) is dereferenced inside an `unsafe` block to produce multiple concurrent exclusive mutable references (`&mut T`) pointing to the same memory address.
why_bad: In Rust, the reference aliasing model relies on the absolute invariant that `&mut` references are completely exclusive. Breaking this invariant causes immediate Undefined Behavior (UB). The compiler may optimize reads/writes under the assumption of exclusivity, leading to silent memory corruption.
detection: Look for `unsafe` blocks dereferencing a single pointer to assign to multiple `&mut` reference variables that are active concurrently.
source: *Rust for Rustaceans* by Jon Gjengset (Chapter 7, "Unsafe Rust", "Interior Mutability").
